preRegistration: Origins, horizons, methods and metrics fixed before any result was seen. At each origin every method is refit on data up to and including the origin month only; the next 1–3 months are then scored. 6 origins × 3 horizons (the Aug-2026 origin contributes h=1 only; Jul-2026 h=1–2).

methods.label: Rolling 6-month average
methods.description: Mean of the last 6 months, held flat.

methods.label: Rolling 12-month average (today's method)
methods.description: Mean of the last 12 months, held flat. This is the brief's current method.

methods.label: Damped Holt-Winters ETS (ours)
methods.description: statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing: additive damped trend + additive seasonality, period 12.

headline.scope: Products A + B, all 5 countries, merged customers (golden IDs)
headline.plainBaseline: Today's method is off by 15 units per 100 ordered
headline.plainOurs: Ours is off by 12 units per 100 ordered
headline.plainBiasBaseline: Today's method tends to under-forecast by 11.5%

winLoss.sentence: Ours beats today's method in 6 of 10 country × product cells; today's method wins 4 (SG·A, SG·B, MY·A, MY·B). Losses are shown, not hidden.

productC.note: Product C (instruments) is lumpy and tender-driven: neither method is good. C is planned from the tender/PR pipeline, not from a time-series forecast, and is excluded from the headline.

intervalMethod: P10/P90 = ETS point forecast × the 10th/90th percentile of actual ÷ forecast ratios from this backtest, pooled within product.
